  closed: NotRequired[int]
  mode: Literal['filtered', 'throttled']
  opened: NotRequired[int]
class StatsDashboardStale(TypedDict)
  reason: StatsDashboardStaleReason
  route: str
StatsDashboardStaleReason = Literal['loki_failed', 'loki_budget']
class TelemetryReadRecovered(TypedDict)
  signal: str
  source: str
  stale_duration_s: float
class TelemetryReadStale(TypedDict)
  action: str
  age_s: float | None
  reason: str
  signal: str
  source: str
  threshold_s: int
